verdicts.justification: PIL on the committed gif: 'frames= 900 size= (640, 480) duration_ms= 30' -- 900 x 30 ms = 27 s playback for a duration=30 s animation (~10% fast). Root cause verified in code: plotly_backend.py computes frame_ms = int(round(1000/30)) = 33 ms, but GIF stores delays in centiseconds so 33 ms quantizes to 3 cs = 30 ms (PIL reads back 30). At 10 fps the delay is exact (100 ms), matching the auditor's control.
